prompts.initialAttack:
Use case: identity-preserve / text-localization.
Asset type: production transparent sprite-sheet add-on for an existing children's typing RPG.
Input images 1–4 are character identity references in ROW ORDER. Preserve each child's face, hair, outfit, backpack, shoes and hand-painted crisp chibi pixel-art rendering.
Create ONE exact 4 columns × 4 rows contact sheet, square 2048×2048, each cell 512×512, fully TRANSPARENT background, NO grid lines and NO labels.
Rows top to bottom:
1 brown-haired boy with red scarf, navy jacket and shorts.
2 brown-haired girl with ponytail, pink bow and pink hoodie, dark skirt.
3 dark navy-haired boy with ROUND GLASSES, teal jacket, shorts and backpack. Keep glasses in EVERY frame.
4 blond explorer boy with goggles on his head, tan jacket and backpack.
All characters face right, 3/4 side view. Each is same size and anchored at the same foot baseline (y=440 inside its cell); feet around x=210, body about 290 px tall. Leave transparent gutters so sprites never touch neighboring cells. Complete head, scarf, limbs, feet and magic fit inside each cell.
Columns left to right show a readable typing attack animation:
1 anticipation: firm feet, both hands near a small floating typing pad in front of chest, focused face.
2 tap: right hand taps the pad, left hand stabilizes; a small luminous cream key tile shows exactly the Korean syllable "가".
3 impact: both hands finish a forward typing gesture, a compact cyan/gold energy burst to the right contains exactly the Korean syllable "나" on one prominent tile.
4 recovery: hands settle to the ready pose, small fading gold sparks and a tile showing exactly "다".
Tiles use dark clear correctly formed Hangul. NO Roman/Latin letters anywhere, no ABC/QWERTY, no digits, no speech bubbles, no weapons. No extra characters or animals. No painted ground or shadows. Restrained VFX so the child silhouette remains clear. Keep head and torso scale strictly consistent across four frames, feet anchored; avoid teleport, jumping or exaggerated different poses. Deliver a clean game-ready true-alpha PNG sheet.
prompts.attack: Edit target: the supplied 4x4 Korean character attack sprite sheet. Preserve the 16 characters and Korean 가 나 다 tiles, poses, dimensions and layout EXACTLY. Replace ONLY the gray-white checkerboard background with absolutely uniform solid vivid magenta #FF00FF. No checkerboard, no texture, no gradient, no painted shadows. This solid chroma-key background will be removed during game sprite packing. Preserve clean dark silhouette edges. Do not redraw subjects or add anything.
prompts.walk: Use case: identity-preserve game sprite animation. Four identity reference portraits correspond to the four ROWS. Create ONE square 4 columns x 4 rows character WALK CYCLE sprite sheet. Flat solid vivid magenta #FF00FF background, no checkerboard, no labels, no grid, no text or effects. Row1 brown-haired boy red scarf navy jacket shorts backpack; row2 brown-haired ponytail girl pink bow pink hoodie dark skirt; row3 navy-haired boy ROUND GLASSES teal jacket shorts backpack; row4 blond boy goggles on head tan jacket shorts backpack. Match reference faces, outfits and crisp hand-painted chibi pixel-art. ALL 16 bodies face RIGHT in clean side view; show both arms and both legs, no facing-camera poses. Four successive gait phases left to right: LEFT leg forward contact and RIGHT leg back with opposite arm forward; passing pose LEFT leg supporting while RIGHT knee swings forward; RIGHT leg forward contact and LEFT leg back with opposite arm forward; passing pose RIGHT leg supporting while LEFT knee swings forward. The near/far feet MUST swap which one is forward between columns1and3. Small natural knee bend, no exaggerated kick, no airborne jump. Exact equal cells with 12% empty gutters, feet same baseline at 85% cell height and hips same xcenter, identical head/torso size in all frames. Full bodies and scarf entirely inside each cell. No ground shadows, no weapons, no tiles. Designed for a seamless looping walk, contact-pass-contact-pass.
prompts.pet: Use case: identity-preserve game sprite animation. Four pet portrait references correspond to the four ROWS. ONE square 4 columns x 4 rows pet WALK CYCLE sheet on perfectly solid vivid magenta #FF00FF background, no checkerboard, no labels/grid/text/shadows. Preserve exact cute hand-painted chibi pixel-art identities: Row1 dark gray and white kitten, red scarf. Row2 white rabbit pink ears, flower necklace. Row3 bright cyan small dragon, cream belly, small yellow horns, blue wings. Row4 brown squirrel, green leafy cape, small pouch, golden acorn staff. ALL pets face RIGHT side view and remain the SAME size and same foot baseline in four cells. Four genuinely distinct sequential gait frames left-to-right: left/front-near paw forward contact, passing pose, opposite paw forward contact, opposite passing pose. Kitten and rabbit on four paws with alternating contacts, calm grounded trot (rabbit small hop only2%height). Dragon and squirrel on two hind feet with alternating foot forward/behind; dragon wings tuck and sway, squirrel holds staff in the same hand each frame and tail follows subtly. Small smooth motion, no huge jump, no facial or costume changes. Equal 4x4 cells, generous 12% magenta gutters around every full silhouette including tails, staff and ears. No cut-off elements. No sparks, no letters, no Roman alphabet. This is a production loop sprite sheet; spacing and left-right foot alternation matter.
